name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2025-10-13, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.63 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
